body.message:
Good morning,

I have just sent an email to the deposit team with my bank details and attached the relevant documents, including my Mashreq bank details, booking confirmation and payment receipt.

My booking reference is GY-XYC7tVD4, and the security deposit is AED 3,000.

I’m checked out of the apartment this morning and I am travelling out of the country today. I would really appreciate it if you could kindly assist by speaking to the relevant team and seeing whether the refund can be expedited.

I urgently need the funds today

Thank you very much for your understanding and support.
